subject: pe
title: Skill Classification
welcome_lead: Open or closed, gross or fine — every skill has a profile.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on skill classification continua.
final_note: Knowing where a skill sits on each continuum guides practice design.

concepts.def: Performed in unpredictable environment (e.g., football pass).
Performed in predictable environment (e.g., free throw).
Uses large muscle groups (e.g., long jump).
Uses small muscle groups (e.g., snooker cue action).
Clear start and end (e.g., golf swing).
Sequence of discrete elements (e.g., gymnastics routine).

walkthroughs.body_html: Each skill maps along several continua: open–closed, gross–fine, discrete–serial–continuous, self-paced–externally paced.
Variable practice and game-realistic scenarios suit open skills.

mcqs.q: A football pass during a match is best classified as:
options: Open skill
Closed skill
Continuous gross
Self-paced

mcqs.q: Snooker cueing is best classified as:
options: Fine, closed, self-paced
Gross, open, externally paced
Gross, closed, externally paced
Fine, open, externally paced

mcqs.q: Is a tennis serve a closed or open skill?
options: Closed - performed in a predictable, self-paced environment.
Fine motor only.
A pivot joint.
Open - because tennis is a fast-paced sport.

mcqs.q: What type of joint is the knee?
options: A hinge joint.
A ball and socket joint.
Fine motor only.
A pivot joint.

mcqs.q: What does the 'I' in FITT stand for?
options: Interval.
Improvement.
A pivot joint.
Intensity (how hard you train).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Discrete skill”?
options: Performed in unpredictable environment (e.g., football pass).
Uses large muscle groups (e.g., long jump).
Clear start and end (e.g., golf swing).
Uses small muscle groups (e.g., snooker cue action).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Gross skill”?
options: Clear start and end (e.g., golf swing).
Uses large muscle groups (e.g., long jump).
Performed in predictable environment (e.g., free throw).
Sequence of discrete elements (e.g., gymnastics routine).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Open skill”?
options: Performed in unpredictable environment (e.g., football pass).
Sequence of discrete elements (e.g., gymnastics routine).
Uses large muscle groups (e.g., long jump).
Uses small muscle groups (e.g., snooker cue action).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Fine skill”?
options: Clear start and end (e.g., golf swing).
Performed in unpredictable environment (e.g., football pass).
Performed in predictable environment (e.g., free throw).
Uses small muscle groups (e.g., snooker cue action).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Closed skill”?
options: Performed in unpredictable environment (e.g., football pass).
Uses small muscle groups (e.g., snooker cue action).
Uses large muscle groups (e.g., long jump).
Performed in predictable environment (e.g., free throw).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Serial skill”?
options: Performed in unpredictable environment (e.g., football pass).
Uses small muscle groups (e.g., snooker cue action).
Clear start and end (e.g., golf swing).
Sequence of discrete elements (e.g., gymnastics routine).
